name: Moseushi (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Moseushi town emblem in green: a ring with jagged breaks, forming a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Moseushi, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 15 June 1968.

features.role: Moseushi town emblem — a ring with jagged breaks, forming a stylised character
